# Tender Response — MRE-2026-02
**Visakoivu Oy** to Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds the required certifications, including F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen pätevyys and a Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.1 Fire protection.** Fire protection systems are maintained on a scheduled basis in line with statutory inspection intervals.

**4.2 Corrective maintenance response times.** Standard corrective faults are attended within one working day of the call being logged.

**4.3 Emergency response.** Emergency situations are covered by an on-call arrangement with response commencing within two hours of the call.

**4.4 Environmental management.** Works are carried out under our environmental management arrangements.

**4.5 Asset register handover.** A full asset register and associated documentation will be handed over at contract commencement and kept current throughout the term, including equipment records, service history and warranty documentation for all covered systems.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Cost breakdown.** A full cost breakdown by property and system is provided with the quotation.

**5.2 Payment terms.** 30 days net from invoice date.

## 6. Submission requirements

**6.1 Personnel.** CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract are attached.

**6.2 Pricing.** Prices are set out in EUR/m²/year, as required.

## Annex A

Visakoivu Oy operates an environmental management system, certified to NMSB 74210:2015, covering the works described in this tender.

Visakoivu Oy is a 180-person technical and facility services company based in Jyväskylä, with experience across food production and cold storage environments and staff working across LVI, sähkö, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistönhoito. We look forward to supporting Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy's facilities.
